epoch_engine.entity: The Epoch Engine — the wave/evolution lineage itself
epoch_engine.name: AEONFORGE
epoch_engine.rationale: Where waves are forged across ages. Not a module — the machinery that makes modules exist across time.

living_atlas.entity: The Living Atlas — the dashboard hub that maps the organism
living_atlas.name: ATLAS LUMEN
living_atlas.rationale: The light-cartography of every organ. One hundred maps drawn from one organism's pulse.

chrono_forge.entity: The Chrono-Forge — the temporal engine binding past/present/future
chrono_forge.name: HOROLOGIUM
chrono_forge.rationale: Latin for great clock. The verification layer that proves each moment against the next. Time, audited.

hex_language.entity: The Hex Language — the organism's own script
hex_language.name: HEXANTHRA
hex_language.rationale: Hex + anthos (flower). The language that blooms into grammar, opcodes, and living rituals as the organism speaks itself.

underworld.entity: The Underworld — the shadow organism beneath the surface
underworld.name: KATABASIS
underworld.rationale: Greek: the descent into the underworld. Where root-ghosts, cavern clocks, and echo-economies mirror the light above.
